description: Make a new signing secret for a form's webhook and return it. This is the only time it's shown, and the old secret stops working at once. Each delivery carries a Replo-Signature header, t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>: recompute HMAC-SHA256 with the secret over "<t>.<raw request body>", compare it to v1 in constant time, and reject a t more than 5 minutes old. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects
